mod.name: Advantageous Game Options (former Cheat Collection)
mod.description:
A collection of optional gameplay modifications to customize and enhance your Heroes III experience:

• Unlimited Build – allows constructing unlimited buildings per day in towns
• Unlimited Heroes – removes hero cap per player
• Campaign Unlocker – unlocks all campaigns from the start, playable in any order
• Accumulating Dwellings – dwellings accumulate creatures every week instead of resetting
• Black Market Restock – restocks Black Markets every 7 days
• No Special Weeks – disables random special weeks and months
• Double Weeks for All Creatures – every creature can receive a double growth month
mod.accumulating-dwellings.name: Accumulating Dwellings
mod.accumulating-dwellings.description: Neutral and player-owned dwellings will accumulate creatures every week instead of resetting their growth.
mod.all-double-weeks.name: Double Months for All Creatures
mod.all-double-weeks.description: Allows every creature to receive a double growth month, ignoring the predefined list.
mod.black-market-restock.name: Black Market Restock
mod.black-market-restock.description: Restocks items in Black Markets every 7 days instead of never refreshing.
mod.campaign-unlocker.name: Campaign Unlocker
mod.campaign-unlocker.description: Unlocks all campaigns, allowing you to play any of them right from the start without following the default order.
mod.no-special-weeks.name: No Special Weeks
mod.no-special-weeks.description:
Disables random special weeks and months such as double growth, plague, or creature weeks. Does not affect scripted weeks like "Deity of Fire."

On Horn of the Abyss maps, this setting has no effect and the value from the map will be used instead.
mod.skill-direct.name: Choose skill directly
mod.skill-direct.description: Allows to choose the skill directly after levelup
mod.unlimited-build.name: Unlimited Build
mod.unlimited-build.description: Removes the one-building-per-day limit in towns, allowing you to construct as many buildings as you want each turn. This mod does not grant unlimited resources.
mod.unlimited-heroes.name: Unlimited Heroes
mod.unlimited-heroes.description: Removes the limit on the number of heroes per player, allowing you to recruit as many as you want.
